summary: 1923 50-ft Aermotor LL-25 tower on Kiowa Mountain in the Carson NF; 1935 CCC observer's cabin; registered 1996; a 2020 report urges NRHP re-evaluation.

events.note: Observer's cabin at the base built by the Civilian Conservation Corps
Registered December 30, 1996; nominated by Kurt L. Winchester, District Ranger

Report says re-evaluate and nominate if eligible; lists Kiowa with the R (restoration or rehabilitation) code. Year from the report's title, 2020 Year-End Report (in the text, cabin 85 years old and lookout 97)

notes_for_editor: History is well sourced (Register, Forest Lookouts page, 2020 report agree on 1923 and 1935). Current status is thin: no staffing, access or rental source found. The 1996 'still in active use' line is about 30 years old and the story now dates it to 1996. The 2020 report is titled '2020 Year-End Report', so the year is stated in the source. The Forest Lookouts page misspells the county as 'Rio Ariba'. Who erected the 1923 tower is not stated. The brief's 1935 'modified' is corrected to built. A Carson NF Facebook post surfaced in search but did not fetch and is not used. No photos added.
